description: Device signing (#240): apply a commit prepared by net.openfederation.repo.prepareCommit with the device's signature over exactly its unsignedCommit bytes. The signature is checked against the DID's current atproto key, read from PLC on every call. The commit applies only while the repository's root is still the one it was built on. A handle can be submitted once, by the account that prepared it.

sig.description: Base64 compact (64-byte, low-S) ECDSA signature over unsignedCommit.

writes.description: Per write: { collection, rkey, uri, cid (create and update) }.

errors.name: UnknownCommit
errors.description: No such prepared commit for this account: already submitted, or never prepared here.

errors.name: CommitExpired
errors.description: The prepared commit expired; prepare again.

errors.name: DeviceSigningOff
errors.description: Device signing is off for this account (or PLC names this server's key again, which turns it off).

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.description: The signature does not verify against the DID's current atproto key.

errors.name: RepoHeadMoved
errors.description: The repository changed since the commit was prepared; prepare again.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The PLC directory could not be read.
